verdict.rationale: Clerky is a SaaS legal-paperwork platform, and a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for that kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, cookie controls, or any opt-out setting. The change-logging feature (clerky-docs-4) is an audit trail, not a tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
